titel: Flies Don't Live For Just One Day

beats.say: That fly in your kitchen... won't die *tomorrow.*
Rudi heard flies only live *one day.* So he just *waits.*
He stares at it all *night.* Next morning, it's still *buzzing.*
Waiting didn't work, so Rudi left for a whole *week.* He came back to a fly *family.*
A house fly usually lives about *three weeks.* Some make it to two *months.*
One female can lay up to *five hundred* eggs.
And they become new flies in just *one week.*
Oh, and flies can't chew. They spit on your food to *melt it.*
So leaving for a week? That gave them a *head start.*
Cover your food, empty the *bin*, and open a window so it can *leave.*
So next time Rudi wants to wait it out... remember:
